unitTitle: The Loch Ness Monster — Episode 1: The Accident
scanNote:
25-BET. Loch Ness 1-epizodiga mashqlar.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 2-mashq (3 tartib), 3-mashq (4 ta T/F), 4-mashq (5 predlog), 5-mashq (8 buyruq gap egasi), 6-mashq (4+7 olmosh), 7-mashq (4 rasm, 5 pufakcha), 8-mashq (krossvord), 10-mashq (8 so'z) — jami 48 ta javob.

⚠ AUDIO KERAK EMAS: 2-mashqda 'listen and put in order' deyilgan, lekin uchala gapning tartibi 24-betdagi hikoyadan aniq chiqadi (idorada → Loch Nessda → qayiqda).

⚠ 4-MAShQ — TRANSPORT 'ON' BILAN: 'ON the train', 'ON a boat' — 'in the train' XATO.
  ⚠ Lekin joy va narsa ichida 'IN': in the office, in his hand, in all the papers.
  ⚠ ISTISNO (kitobda yo'q, lekin bilish kerak): 'IN a car', 'IN a taxi' — kichik yopiq transportda 'in'.

⚠ 5-MAShQ — SAKKIZ BUYRUQ GAP VA ULARNING EGASI:
  Mayk (2 ta): 'Look at this', 'Go to Loch Ness'
  Devid (4 ta): 'Let's hire a boat', 'Be careful', 'Sit down', 'Don't stand up'
  Sandra (2 ta): 'Take some photographs', 'Help me'
  ⚠ Buyruq gapda EGA yozilmaydi — kim aytganini faqat kontekstdan bilamiz.

⚠ 6-MAShQ — TO'LDIRUVChI OLMOShLARI: 'Look at HER' (ayol), 'HIM' (sirkchi), 'IT' (kenguru), 'THEM' (odamlar).
  ⚠ 'kangaroo' — hayvon, jinsi noma'lum → IT.

⚠ 8-MAShQ KROSSVORDI: paper · desk · train · photograph · boat · monster → yechim so'z EDITOR (Maykning kasbi).

⚠ 3-MAShQ 1-BAND: 'David is the editor' → NOTO'G'RI. Devid — JURNALIST (reporter), muharrir esa MAYK. Bu farqni 24-betdagi kirish matni ochiq aytadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 24 and point to the editor, the reporters and the monster. What do you know about the Loch Ness monster?
exercises.instructionUz: 24-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va muharrir, muxbirlar hamda maxluqni ko'rsating. Loch Ness maxluqi haqida nima bilasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
Rasmlarda kim kim:
  the editor    — Mayk Betl (keksaroq erkak, ko'zoynakli, qizil bantli)
  the reporters — Sandra (sariq sochli ayol) va Devid (qora sochli erkak)
  the monster   — ko'lda ko'ringan uzun bo'yinli kulrang maxluq

sentences.en: The Loch Ness Monster is a creature from Scottish stories.
sentences.uz: Loch Ness maxluqi — Shotlandiya afsonalaridagi jonzot.

sentences.en: Loch Ness is a big, deep lake in Scotland.
sentences.uz: Loch Ness — Shotlandiyadagi katta va chuqur ko'l.

sentences.en: There are a lot of stories about Nessie, but there aren't any real photographs.
sentences.uz: Nessi haqida ko'p hikoyalar bor, lekin haqiqiy suratlar yo'q.
sentences.noteUz: Unit 3 grammatikasi: a lot of ... but ... aren't ANY ...

sentences.en: Many tourists go to Loch Ness every year.
sentences.uz: Har yili ko'p sayyoh Loch Nessga boradi.
sentences.noteUz: tourist = sayyoh. Nessie afsonasi Shotlandiyaga sayyoh keltiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and put the sentences in the order you hear them.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va gaplarni eshitgan tartibingizda joylashtiring.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Tartibni 24-betdagi hikoyadan ham topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchta gap hikoyaning turli joyidan olingan.
Hikoyani boshidan oxirigacha eslang:
  1) Idorada Mayk topshiriq beradi
  2) Ko'l bo'yida qayiq ijaraga olishadi
  3) Qayiqda Sandraga ogohlantirish beriladi

pairs.right: Let's hire a boat and look for it. (Devid, ko'l bo'yida)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode, then mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing, so'ng gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapni hikoyadagi aniq gap bilan solishtiring.
Bittagina so'z farq qilsa ham, javob F bo'ladi.

items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Kirish matnida: 'Mike Battle is the editor.' Devid — muxbir (reporter).

items.sentence: 2  There are photographs of the monster in all the papers.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Mayk aytadi: 'there aren't ANY photographs!' Aynan shuning uchun ularni jo'natyapti.
NOTO'G'RI. Sandra aytadi: 'Where is it? I can't see it!'

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QOIDA:

  IN — yopiq joy yoki narsa ICHIDA:
       in the office, in his hand, in the papers

  ON — transport vositasi USTIDA:
       on the train, on a boat, on a bus, on a plane

TRANSPORT QOIDASI — muhim:
  ON  — poyezd, avtobus, samolyot, qayiq, velosiped
        (ichida yurish mumkin bo'lgan katta transport)
  IN  — mashina, taksi
        (kichik, o'tirib yuriladigan)

  ✅ on the train / on a boat / in a car
  ❌ in the train / in a boat

'in the papers' — gazetada YOZILGAN degani (sahifa ichida).

items.textEn: 1  David and Sandra are ____ the office.
items.whyUz: Idora — yopiq joy → IN the office.
Qo'lda ushlab turibdi → IN his hand. 'on his hand' — qo'l ustida yotibdi degani.

items.textEn: 3  There are stories about the monster ____ all the papers.
items.whyUz: Gazeta ICHIDA yozilgan → IN the papers.

items.textEn: 4  Sandra and David are ____ the train.
items.whyUz: Katta transport → ON the train. 'in the train' NOTO'G'RI.

items.textEn: 5  Sandra and David are ____ a boat.
items.whyUz: Qayiq ham transport → ON a boat.

rule.explanationUz:
Buyruq mayli — kimgadir NIMA QILISHNI aytish.
Bu ingliz tilidagi ENG SODDA gap turi: ega yo'q, zamon yo'q,
faqat FE'L.

  Look at this.    — Bunga qara.
  Go to Loch Ness. — Loch Nessga bor.
  Sit down!        — O'tir!

O'zbekchada buyruq qo'shimcha bilan yasaladi (qara, bor, o'tir).
Inglizchada esa fe'lning ASOS SHAKLI o'zgarishsiz ishlatiladi.

rules.enRule: We form affirmative orders or instructions with the base form of the verb.

rules.uzRule: INKOR buyruq — don't + fe'lning asos shakli.
rules.enRule: We form negative orders or instructions with don't + base form of the verb.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — ega qo'shish:
  ❌ You look at this.   ✅ Look at this.
  ❌ You don't stand up. ✅ Don't stand up.

Buyruqda 'you' AYTILMAYDI — u o'z-o'zidan tushuniladi.

Va fe'l HECH QACHON o'zgarmaydi:
  ❌ Looks at this.  ❌ Looking at this.  ❌ To look at this.
  ✅ Look at this.
rule.noteUz:
MULOYIM QILISH:
Buyruq qo'pol eshitilishi mumkin. Yumshatish uchun 'please' qo'shiladi:
  Sit down.        — O'tir. (buyruq)
  Please sit down. — Iltimos, o'tiring. (muloyim)
  Sit down, please. — ham to'g'ri

'Let's ...' — birgalikda qilishga taklif, buyruq emas:
  Let's hire a boat. — Qayiq ijaraga olaylik.
rule.extraUz:
BUYRUQ QAYERDA UCHRAYDI:
  • ko'rsatmalarda: Open your books. Turn left.
  • ogohlantirishda: Be careful! Don't touch!
  • retseptlarda:   Add the salt. Mix well.
  • belgilarda:     Push. Pull. Do not enter.

Rasmiy yozuvda 'don't' o'rniga 'do not' yoziladi:
  Do not stand up. (rasmiy)
  Don't stand up.  (og'zaki)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode again and find eight sentences which are orders. Who says each sentence?
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni qayta o'qing va buyruq bo'lgan sakkizta gapni toping. Har birini kim aytadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Hikoyada AYNAN SAKKIZTA buyruq bor.
Namuna: Look at this. (Mike)

Ularni topish osonlashtiruvchi belgi:
  • gap FE'L bilan boshlanadi (ega yo'q)
  • ko'pincha undov belgisi (!) bilan tugaydi

Kim aytadi:
  Mike   — 2 ta (idorada topshiriq beradi)
  David  — 4 ta (Sandrani ogohlantiradi)
  Sandra — 2 ta

items.question: Look!
items.whyUz: 'Sandra! Look! The monster!' — eng qisqa buyruq, bitta so'z.

items.question: Be careful!
items.whyUz: 'be' — 'to be' fe'lining asos shakli. Buyruqda 'are' emas, 'be' ishlatiladi.

items.question: Don't stand up!
items.whyUz: YAGONA inkor buyruq: don't + asos shakl.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida olmosh gapdagi VAZIFASIGA qarab shaklini o'zgartiradi.

  EGA (fe'ldan OLDIN)      OBYEKT (fe'ldan KEYIN)
  I                        me
  you                      you
  he                       him
  she                      her
  it                       it
  we                       us
  you                      you
  they                     them

Misol:
  SHE is Sandra.   — She — ega, fe'ldan oldin.
  Look at HER.     — her — obyekt, fe'ldan keyin.

O'zbekchada bu 'u' va 'unga/uni' farqiga o'xshaydi.

rules.enRule: Subject pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, you, they) go before verbs as their subjects.
examples: They work for The Morning Sun.

rules.enRule: Object pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, you, them) go after verbs as their objects.

rule.warningUz:
PREDLOGDAN KEYIN ham OBYEKT shakli keladi:
  ✅ Look at HER.     ❌ Look at she.
  ✅ with ME          ❌ with I
  ✅ for THEM         ❌ for they

Oson qoida: fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — DOIM obyekt shakli.
rule.noteUz:
'you' va 'it' o'zgarmaydi — ikkala vazifada ham bir xil:
  YOU are a reporter.  /  I can see YOU.
  IT is huge.          /  Look for IT.

Qolgan oltitasi o'zgaradi: I/me, he/him, she/her, we/us, they/them.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and make sentences using object pronouns, as in the example. Look at her!
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va obyekt olmoshlari bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna: Look at her!

RASMLAR:
  1) ayol            → her
  2) sirk artisti (erkak) → him
  3) kenguru (hayvon)     → it
  4) bir guruh erkaklar   → them

QOIDA: 'at' — predlog, undan keyin DOIM obyekt shakli keladi.

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Ayol → she, lekin predlogdan keyin HER.

exercises.instructionEn: Change the subject pronoun into the object pronoun.
exercises.explanationUz: Butun jadvalni yodlab olish — bu grammatikaning asosi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the speech bubbles with sentences from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Nutq pufakchalarini ro'yxatdagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (hammasi BUYRUQ gapi):
  • Don't be afraid!     — Qo'rqma!
  • Don't worry. It's gone. — Xavotir olma. U ketdi.
  • Take my hand!        — Qo'limdan ushla!
  • Put this on.         — Buni kiy.

Har bir rasmda VAZIYAT bor — unga mos javobni toping.
Berilgan namuna: 1-rasmda ayol 'I'm cold' (Sovqotdim) deydi.

bubbles.whyUz: Sovqotgan odamga kiyim taklif qilinadi. 'put on' — kiymoq.

scenes.picture: 2-rasm — daraxt orqasidagi ayiqdan qo'rqqan ikki kishi

bubbles.whyUz: Qo'rqqan odamga aytiladigan inkor buyruq. 'afraid' = qo'rqqan.

scenes.picture: 3-rasm — suvdagi odam qirg'oqdagi odamga qo'l cho'zadi
4-rasm — it ketgandan keyin erkak bolani tinchlantiradi

bubbles.whyUz: Xavf o'tgandan keyin. 'worry' = xavotir olmoq, 'gone' = ketgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the puzzle to find Mike's job.
exercises.instructionUz: Krossvordni to'ldiring va Maykning kasbini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
Oltita rasm — oltita so'z. Har bir so'zdan bitta harf
vertikal ustunga tushadi va Maykning kasbini hosil qiladi.

  1  gazeta rasmi   → PAPER      (4-harf: E)
  2  yozuv stoli    → DESK       (1-harf: D)
  3  poyezd         → TRAIN      (4-harf: I)
  4  suratli ramka  → PHOTOGRAPH (4-harf: T)
  5  qayiq          → BOAT       (2-harf: O)
  6  maxluq         → MONSTER    (7-harf: R)

  Vertikal: E - D - I - T - O - R  =  EDITOR (muharrir)

Va haqiqatan ham: 'Mike Battle is the editor of the newspaper.'

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the episode, then take roles and read it aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni tinglang, so'ng rollarni bo'lib, ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Audio bo'lmasa ham, rollarni bo'lib o'qish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
ROLLAR:
  Mike   — muharrir (buyruq beradi, qat'iy ohang)
  Sandra — muxbir (savol beradi, keyin qo'rqadi)
  David  — muxbir (tinchlantiradi, ogohlantiradi)

OVOZ CHIQARIB O'QISH nima beradi:
  • talaffuz mustahkamlanadi
  • ohang (intonatsiya) o'rganiladi
  • so'zlar yaxshiroq esda qoladi

OHANG QOIDASI:
  Buyruq   — ovoz PASAYADI:  Sit down. ↘
  Undov    — ovoz KUCHAYADI: Help me! ↗
  Ha/yo'q savoli — ovoz KO'TARILADI: Is there a monster? ↗
  So'roq so'zli savol — ovoz PASAYADI: Where is it? ↘

example.speaker: Mike
example.en: There are stories about the Loch Ness Monster in all the papers today, but there aren't any photographs! Go to Loch Ness. I want a story and photographs with it!
example.uz: Bugun barcha gazetalarda Loch Ness maxluqi haqida maqolalar bor, lekin hech qanday surat yo'q! Loch Nessga boringlar. Menga maqola va u bilan birga suratlar kerak!

example.speaker: Sandra
example.en: Is there really a monster, David?

example.speaker: David
example.en: No, I can't. Let's hire a boat and look for it.
example.uz: Yo'q, ko'rmayapman. Qayiq ijaraga olib, uni qidiraylik.

example.speaker: David
example.en: Sandra! Look! The monster! Can you see it? Wow! It's huge!
example.uz: Sandra! Qara! Maxluq! Ko'ryapsanmi? Voy! U ulkan!

example.speaker: Sandra
example.en: Where is it? I can't see it! Quick, take some photographs!
example.uz: U qayerda? Men ko'rmayapman! Tez bo'l, suratga ol!

example.speaker: David
example.en: Sandra, be careful! Sit down! Don't stand up!
example.uz: Sandra, ehtiyot bo'l! O'tir! O'rningdan turma!

example.speaker: Sandra
example.en: Oh no! Help! David! Help me!
example.uz: Voy! Yordam bering! Devid! Menga yordam ber!

exercises.instructionEn: Read the paragraph and fill in the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatboshini o'qing va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu xatboshi — butun epizodning QISQA XULOSASI.
Har bir bo'shliqda birinchi harf va harflar soni berilgan.

TO'LIQ MATN:
'Mike Battle is the editor of The Morning Sun. David and Sandra
are reporters. In the office, Mike shows David and Sandra some
papers. There are stories about Nessie, the monster in Loch Ness,
in all of them. David and Sandra go to Scotland on a train. They
want to take photographs of Nessie. There are boats by the loch.
David and Sandra hire one to look for Nessie. After three hours
on the boat, David sees the monster behind Sandra.'

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to show — ko'rsatmoq
  by      — yonida (by the loch = ko'l yonida)
  one     — bittasi (boats o'rniga: hire ONE = bittasini ijaraga olmoq)
  Scotland — Shotlandiya

items.textEn: Mike Battle is the 1) e_____ of The Morning Sun.
items.whyUz: Kitobda berilgan. 8-mashqdagi krossvord javobi ham shu.

items.textEn: In the office, Mike shows David and Sandra some 2) p_____ .
items.whyUz: p + 5 harf = papers (gazetalar). Mayk qo'lida gazetalar bor edi.

items.textEn: There are stories about Nessie, the 3) m______ in Loch Ness, in all of them.
David and Sandra go to Scotland on a 4) t____ .
items.whyUz: t + 4 harf = train. 'ON a train' — transport qoidasi.

items.textEn: They want to take 5) p__________ of Nessie.
items.whyUz: 'take photographs' — suratga olmoq. Ko'plik, chunki bir nechta surat kerak.

items.textEn: There are 6) b____ by the loch.
David and Sandra hire one to 7) l___ for Nessie.
After three 8) h____ on the boat, David sees the monster behind Sandra.
items.whyUz: h + 4 harf = hours. Hikoyada: 'AFTER THREE HOURS ON THE BOAT...'

exercises.instructionEn: Write descriptions of Mike, Sandra and David.
exercises.instructionUz: Mayk, Sandra va Devidning tavsifini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ODAM TAVSIFI — Unit 2 mavzusi, bu yerda qayta ishlatiladi.

NIMANI YOZISH KERAK:
  1) ismi va kasbi        — He is ... He is a ...
  2) qayerda ishlaydi     — He works for ...
  3) tashqi ko'rinishi     — He is tall/short, he has got ... hair
  4) hikoyada nima qiladi  — In the story, he ...

Quyidagi namunalar — shu to'rt qadam bo'yicha.
24-betdagi rasmga qarab, tashqi ko'rinishni to'ldiring.

structure.modelEn: This is Mike Battle. He is the editor of The Morning Sun.
He is an older man with short grey hair and glasses.
In the story, he gives David and Sandra a new job: go to Loch Ness and take photographs of the monster.
This is Sandra Manning. She is a reporter and she works for The Morning Sun in London.
She is young and slim with long fair hair.
In the story, she goes to Loch Ness with David. She can't see the monster and she falls into the water.
This is David Parr. He is a reporter and he works with Sandra.
He is young and tall with short dark hair.
In the story, he sees the monster first and he tells Sandra to be careful.

groups.explanationUz: Olmosh gapdagi vazifasiga qarab shaklini o'zgartiradi. Fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — obyekt shakli.
Buyruqda fe'l ASOS shaklida qoladi: -s, -ing, 'to' qo'shilmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: Look at this! Sit down! Be careful!
patterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq buyruq. Ega YO'Q — gap to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'ldan boshlanadi.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't stand up! Don't be afraid! Don't worry.
patterns.explanationUz: Inkor buyruq. Har doim 'don't' — ega qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.

patterns.exampleEn: Look at her. Help me! Look for it. Look at them!
patterns.exampleUz: Unga qara. Menga yordam ber! Uni qidir. Ularga qara!
patterns.explanationUz: Fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — doim obyekt shakli (me, him, her, it, us, them).

patterns.exampleEn: She's Sandra. They work for The Morning Sun.
patterns.exampleUz: U — Sandra. Ular 'The Morning Sun' da ishlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Fe'ldan oldin — ega shakli (I, you, he, she, it, we, they).

patterns.exampleEn: Mike shows David and Sandra some papers.
patterns.exampleUz: Mayk Devid va Sandraga gazetalarni ko'rsatadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'show' ikkita to'ldiruvchi oladi: KIMGA + NIMANI.
Tartib: show + odam + narsa (predlogsiz).

patterns.formula: on a train / on a boat — transport.
patterns.exampleEn: David and Sandra go to Scotland on a train.
patterns.exampleUz: Devid va Sandra poyezdda Shotlandiyaga boradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Katta transport bilan ON. Faqat mashina va taksi bilan IN.
